The trolls destroyed {npc:Jerom}'s house, northeast of Edron, just as he was planning to open a new shop. Swim under the mountain with a diving helmet, jump to the top with {item:Boots of Haste} and convince {npc:Chief Grarkharok} to return Jerom's family necklace. You receive an {item:Elvenhair Rope}. It is part of the {wiki:Tibia Tales}.
The trolls destroyed poor Jerom's house, just as he was planning to open a new shop! You can help him get revenge on the trolls who did this to him.
Jerom, northeast of Edron (near Avar Tar)
or {item:Depth Galea}; must be equipped to enter the cave under the mountain
so you can make the jump at the top of the mountain
Alternatively: 200 gp and you keep the {item:Jerom's Family Necklace} (see notes).
At night, {creature:Werebadger|Werebadgers}, {creature:Wereboar|Wereboars} and {creature:Werefox|Werefoxes} may appear in the area. Do the quest during the day if you are a low level.

Creatures drawn in by other players can also show up ({creature:Bear|Bears}, {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}, {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}, {creature:Hunter|Hunters}, {creature:Wisp|Wisps} or {creature:Poacher|Poachers}).

Get to **Edron** by boat (for example, in Thais tell {npc:Captain Bluebear} {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}) and leave the city on foot to the **northeast**, until you are near {npc:Avar Tar}. Talk to {npc:Jerom}: {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}.
Go to the other side of the mountain, north of Jerom's house, and jump into the river. **Equip the {item:Helmet of the Deep} or the {item:Depth Galea}** and swim under the mountain.
Spot to jump into the river
Without one of the helmets equipped you cannot enter the mountain cave.
You drop one floor. Swim to the water vortex and go down one more floor.
Get out of the water and follow the path up as far as you can. From the last stairs, go straight **north**.
Map of the way to the top
You reach the top of the mountain. Equip the {item:Boots of Haste} and run the whole distance so you can make the jump.
Top of the mountain before the jump

Go up and you will find {npc:Chief Grarkharok}. Say {key:hi}, threaten him with {key:kill you}, offer him a {key:lady}, answer {key:yes} and say the name of a female character from your world (it can be yours or anyone else's). He gives you the {item:Jerom's Family Necklace}.

The wiki does not describe another exit: go back the same way to the river where you entered, north of Jerom's house ({coord:33236,31744,7}). Keep the {item:Boots of Haste} and the {item:Helmet of the Deep} (or the {item:Depth Galea}) with you, because the part under the mountain is done by swimming. Then get out of the water and go see {npc:Jerom}, right next door.
Go back to {npc:Jerom} with the necklace and say {key:mission}. He gives you the {item:Elvenhair Rope}.
If you lost the necklace by the time you talk to Jerom about the mission, he gives you 200 gp and says he has already recovered it, instead of the Elvenhair Rope.
In the Quest Log, {npc:Chief Grarkharok} is still waiting for a troll lady; maybe there is another reward if you help him.

Extra chat: Jerom talks about his dream of opening a pet shop ({key:pet}) and his parents' farm ({key:farm}). Chief Grarkharok talks about his hobby of throwing stones at humans ({key:stones}) and his liking for {key:snakes} and {key:frogs}; he eats any dead snake or frog you give him.
